blocks.instruction: Do the following statements agree with the information in the notices? Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

people.name: Oliwia Brennan
people.role: yoga instructor who designed the beginners' class

paragraphs.text: The centre is open from 6.30 a.m. to 10 p.m. Monday to Friday, and from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. at weekends. On public holidays we follow the weekend timetable, except on Christmas Day and New Year's Day, when the building is closed completely. Please note that the last admission to the pool and gym is forty-five minutes before closing, so that staff have time to clean and lock up. The café keeps slightly shorter hours, opening at 8 a.m. every day and serving its final hot drinks at 4 p.m. During the first two weeks of August, the sports hall will be shut while its floor is replaced; badminton and five-a-side bookings for that period will be moved to the hall at Greenway Primary School, a ten-minute walk away. Questions can be emailed to the centre manager, Priya Nandakumar.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Our weekly programme includes yoga, Pilates, circuit training, aqua aerobics and a gentle exercise class for people returning to activity after illness or injury. Most classes last fifty minutes, although the Saturday morning circuit session runs for a full hour and a half. Non-members can reserve a place up to seven days in advance online or at reception. If you can no longer attend, please cancel at least two hours before the start; anyone who fails to turn up three times in a month will lose the right to book ahead for the following four weeks. Newcomers to yoga are encouraged to try the Tuesday evening class, which instructor Oliwia Brennan designed specifically for beginners. Mats and light weights are provided, but we ask you to bring your own towel and a bottle of water. Children aged twelve to fifteen may join adult classes only if a parent or guardian takes part alongside them.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: All swimmers must shower before entering the water. Children under eight must be accompanied in the pool by an adult aged eighteen or over, and one adult may supervise no more than two such children. The pool is divided into lanes during lunchtime and early-morning sessions: choose the slow, medium or fast lane according to your speed, and always swim on the left. Diving is permitted only at the deep end and only when a lifeguard has removed the barrier rope. Inflatable toys are welcome during family sessions on Sunday afternoons but are not allowed at other times. Glass bottles, food and outdoor shoes must not be taken onto the poolside. Our aquatics supervisor, Desmond Achterberg, reminds users that lifeguards' instructions must be followed immediately; anyone who repeatedly ignores them may be asked to leave and could be banned from future sessions.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Non-members pay £5.20 for a single swim and £7 for a gym session or a fitness class. Under-sixteens, students and people over sixty-five receive a reduced rate of £3.50 for any of these activities, provided they can show proof of age or student status. Families of up to two adults and three children can buy a family swim ticket for £14. A ten-visit card, priced at £45, offers better value for regular users and can be shared between members of the same household; however, it expires six months after the date of purchase and cannot be refunded. Badminton courts cost £9 per hour, and racquets can be hired from reception for £1.50 each. Prices were last revised in January and are not expected to change again before the end of the year.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Membership gives unlimited use of the pool, gym and classes, plus priority booking: members can reserve class places fourteen days ahead instead of seven. A standard monthly membership costs £32, while a concession membership, available to the same groups who qualify for reduced single prices, costs £22. You can join at reception or online, but your first visit must include a short induction with a member of the gym team, covering the safe use of equipment. There is no joining fee for anyone who signs up before the end of March. Memberships run on a rolling basis, and you may cancel at any time by giving one full month's notice in writing. If you are unable to exercise because of illness, injury or pregnancy, you can freeze your membership for up to three months without charge; a doctor's note may be requested.
paragraphs.label: E

Questions can be emailed to the centre manager, Priya Nandakumar.

B. Our weekly programme includes yoga, Pilates, circuit training, aqua aerobics and a gentle exercise class for people returning to activity after illness or injury. Most classes last fifty minutes, although the Saturday morning circuit session runs for a full hour and a half. Non-members can reserve a place up to seven days in advance online or at reception. If you can no longer attend, please cancel at least two hours before the start; anyone who fails to turn up three times in a month will lose the right to book ahead for the following four weeks. Newcomers to yoga are encouraged to try the Tuesday evening class, which instructor Oliwia Brennan designed specifically for beginners. Mats and light weights are provided, but we ask you to bring your own towel and a bottle of water. Children aged twelve to fifteen may join adult classes only if a parent or guardian takes part alongside them.

C. All swimmers must shower before entering the water. Under-sixteens, students and people over sixty-five receive a reduced rate of £3.50 for any of these activities, provided they can show proof of age or student status. explanation.en: Section C, the swimming rules, says one adult may supervise no more than two children under eight. Section B mentions children too, but only about joining adult classes with a parent.

explanation.uk: У розділі C, де зібрано правила плавання, сказано, що один дорослий може наглядати не більше ніж за двома дітьми віком до восьми років. У розділі B діти теж згадуються, але лише щодо відвідування занять для дорослих разом із батьками.

explanation.uk: У розділі B сказано, що килимки й гантелі надаються, а рушник і воду учасникам занять треба приносити із собою. У розділі C перелічено те, що НЕ МОЖНА проносити до басейну, а це інше.

explanation.uk: У розділі D сказано, що абонементом на десять відвідувань можуть користуватися різні люди, які живуть в одному домі.

questions.prompt: a way of pausing membership for a period

explanation.en: Section E says members who cannot exercise because of illness, injury or pregnancy can 'freeze' (pause) their membership for free. Cancelling, also in E, ends the membership rather than pausing it.
explanation.ru: В разделе E сказано, что члены клуба, которые не могут заниматься из-за болезни, травмы или беременности, могут бесплатно 'freeze' (приостановить) членство. Отмена членства, о которой тоже говорится в разделе E, прекращает его, а не приостанавливает.
explanation.uk: У розділі E сказано, що члени клубу, які не можуть займатися через хворобу, травму чи вагітність, можуть безкоштовно 'freeze' (призупинити) членство. Скасування членства, про яке теж ідеться в розділі E, припиняє його, а не призупиняє.

questions.prompt: a consequence for people who book places but do not come
questions.evidence: anyone who fails to turn up three times in a month will lose the right to book ahead

explanation.en: Section B says people who miss booked classes three times in a month cannot book ahead for four weeks. Section C also mentions a ban, but that is for ignoring lifeguards, not for missing bookings.
explanation.ru: В разделе B сказано, что тот, кто трижды за месяц пропустил забронированные занятия, не может бронировать заранее в течение четырёх недель. В разделе C тоже упоминается запрет, но он назначается за то, что человек не слушается спасателей, а не за пропуск бронирований.
explanation.uk: У розділі B сказано, що той, хто тричі за місяць пропустив заброньовані заняття, не може бронювати заздалегідь протягом чотирьох тижнів. У розділі C теж згадується заборона, але її призначають за те, що людина не слухається рятувальників, а не за пропуск бронювань.

explanation.uk: У розділі B сказано, що заняття у вівторок було розроблене для початківців, тобто для тих, хто раніше не займався йогою.
